yaml_imported.description:
The MeteoGalicia YAML configuration for `{identifier}` was successfully imported as a config entry. Remove this block from `configuration.yaml` and restart Home Assistant:

```yaml
{configuration}
```

The imported entry keeps the entity identifiers and update interval. This notification will disappear after the block is removed and Home Assistant is restarted.
